title: -T520 Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Scorpion EXO T520 Matte Black is tuned for city streets, daily work runs, and weekend joyrides, delivering responsive balance and confident road feel. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at a featherweight 1347g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~88 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Sport touring full face with EverClear anti-fog and Ellip-Tec II face shield.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; may feel tight on very round heads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Scorpion EXO -T520 Matte Black: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Scorpion EXO's Full Face lineup, the -T520 Matte Black brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Scorpion EXO T520 Matte Black represents Scorpion EXO's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Scorpion EXO T520 Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
